admission.title: Admission process
admission.subtitle: Six simple steps from the first visit to the first lesson.

step1.title: Visit the school
step1.body: Our admissions team welcomes you on campus and answers every question.

step2.title: Get to know us
step2.body: A personal tour of classrooms, labs, the library and the sports hall.

step3.title: Parent interview
step3.body: A short conversation to make sure our goals and yours match.

step4.title: Placement test
step4.body: A light test in maths and English to place your child in the right class.

step5.title: Meeting with the school psychologist
step5.body: A friendly chat about readiness, behaviour and how your child learns best.

step6.title: Enrolment & contract
step6.body: Sign the contract, get the uniform and portal login — and start lessons.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Can tuition be paid in instalments?
faq.a1: Yes. You can pay yearly, per semester, or in 10 equal monthly instalments.
faq.a2: Yes, tuition includes four balanced, fresh meals a day, planned by a children's nutritionist and cooked in our campus kitchen.
faq.a3: Yes. Students wear our classic navy school uniform, designed for comfort and everyday campus activities.
faq.a4: Yes. Safe, supervised minibus routes cover all major districts of Tashkent.
faq.a5: We give a 10% discount for the second child and 15% for the third and every next child enrolled at the same time.
faq.q6: How can I follow my child's grades and attendance?
faq.a6: Parents sign in to the Campusly portal to see published grades, attendance and homework for each child, on the phone or the computer.
